training_data.title: Consent to use materials
training_data.body: I consent to the use of the texts and correspondence of a real person, which I upload, to train the RAG model of their persona in the Gate app.

not_a_replacement.title: Understanding the limitations
not_a_replacement.body: I understand that Gate does not replace a real person and is not a substitute for professional psychological help. If I struggle to cope with the loss, I will reach out to specialists or people close to me.

Safety.crisisResponse:
I'm sorry you're going through such a hard time right now — and I'm glad you told me about it.

Please reach out for help right now — it matters, and you deserve support. Free 24/7 mental health helpline: {hotline}.

If there is immediate danger to life, please call emergency services or reach out to someone close who can be with you right now.

I'm a companion app, not a specialist, and I can't replace professional help in a situation like this.

hero.intro: We built this app hoping to make it a little easier to live through the loss of someone close. Here you can continue a conversation with the person you miss — say what was left unsaid, remember how they spoke and who they were.
hero.disclaimer: Important: Gate does not replace a real person and is not a substitute for live human connection or professional psychological help. If you're struggling with loss, please reach out to specialists or people close to you.

steps.title: Share materials
steps.body: Upload conversations, letters, or notes about the person — their persona is built from these.

steps.title: We build a persona
steps.body: Gate carefully studies their manner of speech and character and puts together a persona — based only on what you upload.

steps.title: Continue the conversation
steps.body: Say what was left unsaid — the persona responds in the character of the person you miss.

items.title: Privacy
items.body: All materials are stored privately and used only for your persona. You can delete everything at any time — from settings, permanently.

items.title: Not a substitute for a specialist
items.body: Gate does not replace a real person and is not a substitute for live human connection or professional psychological help. If it gets hard, please reach out to people close to you or specialists.

items.title: You're always in control
items.body: Talk at your own pace — from daily messages to complete silence until you write first. Settings are available any time.

items.question: What is Gate?
items.answer: Gate is a companion app for people living through the loss of someone close. You upload conversations or notes about the person, and the app creates their persona so you can say what was left unsaid.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: Uploaded materials are stored privately and used only to train your persona. You can permanently delete the persona and all data at any time, from settings.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes, Gate is currently free to use.

items.question: Who can sign up?
items.answer: Registration is currently only available with a .ru domain email.

items.question: What if a conversation becomes too hard?
items.answer: Gate is not a substitute for a specialist. If a conversation becomes difficult, the app will show a free psychological helpline number. Please reach out to specialists or people close to you if you need to.

footer.tagline: A companion app for people living through loss
